title: Brad M. Reedy, PhD
excerpt: Editorial research draft about Brad Reedy, Utah wilderness therapy clinician, co-owner of Second Nature and co-founder of Evoke Therapy Programs, and one of the industry's most visible public voices. No incident is attributed to him personally.

meta.person_role: Co-founder and clinical director of Evoke Therapy Programs; co-founder of Second Nature Wilderness; author and podcast host

person_organizations: Utah Board of Child and Family Services
